From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Contractor -> FTE: Offer comp & headcount request for Asha R.

Team —

Asha Ramirez (contractor in Search Relevance) has been with us for ~8 months and the manager (Rishi) is requesting conversion to FTE. Quick summary: excellent performance, full-time scope confirmed, currently on 1099 at $80/hr. Manager proposes converting to L4 IC band.

Proposed package (first pass):
- Base: $150,000
- Target bonus: 10%
- Sign-on: $8,000 (one-time) to make comp competitive given lost contractor overtime/benefits
- Equity: 0.15% (RSU grant target)
- Start: 2025-12-01 (subject to approvals)

Attachments: comp_band_reference.xlsx (recommended band), headcount_form.docx (in draft).

Ask: Finance + People Ops — can we get headcount + comp approval by EOD Friday 11/21 so we can issue an offer and start DocuSign flow? If we need to tweak base or sign-on to stay within approved band/budget, call it out here.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Hiring Manager, Search
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-18T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Contractor -> FTE: Offer comp & headcount request for Asha R.

Thanks Monica — quick thoughts after looking at the comp_band_reference.xlsx:
- Band mid for L4 is $138k; $150k is above midpoint but still within market for a high-performing IC in SF. If manager insists on $150k, we should offset with a smaller sign-on.
- Proposed alternative: Base $145,000 + 12% target bonus + $6,000 sign-on. That keeps OTE reasonable and reduces ongoing fixed cost.
- Confirm if the contractor budget (vendor spend) is currently being repurposed — if so, conversion should net to zero headcount delta for 2025 spend. If not, this will need explicit Q4 budget approval.

One note: please confirm the manager has approved the final numbers in writing (email is fine) and that the hiring packet (headcount_form.docx) is filled showing the contractor line being closed.

-Karthik
Head of Recruiting Operations
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>

Date: 2025-11-19T08:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Contractor -> FTE: Offer comp & headcount request for Asha R.

Monica —

Finance perspective: we are in a soft hiring freeze for new roles, but conversions that replace contractor spend are generally approvable if you can show the vendor/contractor budget is being reallocated. Please attach the contractor invoices or PO line showing the current spend (so I can mark the transfer in the ledger).

If you can commit to the $145k + $6k sign-on suggested by Karthik, I can approve the headcount transfer on the condition that 2025 hiring spend remains within our current Q4 cap. Otherwise we need VP-level carve-out.

I've attached a short note on how to log the budget transfer (budget_note.pdf).

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
VP, Finance

Subject: Re: Contractor -> FTE: Offer comp & headcount request for Asha R.

Hi all —

People Ops checklist items:
- Benefits effective date for conversions = first of month following start; if Asha starts 2025-12-01, benefits effective 2026-01-01 (open enrollment apply).
- Equity: if we grant RSUs we need grant date and vesting schedule; default is 4 years with 1-year cliff unless exceptions made.
- Please confirm manager's approval of the final offer in the email thread (that's our audit trail).

I'll prepare the DocuSign offer once comp numbers and headcount are finalized. I put a draft offer in the HR folder and included a placeholder start date. Also note: for contractor conversions we typically offer pro-rated PTO accrual on day 1; confirm if you want that.

Link to draft offer (internal): https://drive.redwood.com/HR/offers/asha_ramirez_draft

—Evelyn

Subject: Final: Asha R. conversion — approved comp package and headcount

Thanks for the quick turn-around. After speaking with Rishi and reviewing budget_notes, we will proceed with the following final package (manager sign-off below):
- Base: $148,000
- Target bonus: 12%
- Sign-on: $6,000 (one-time, paid on first payroll)
- Equity: 0.12% RSUs, 4-year vesting with 1-year cliff
- Start date: 2025-12-01
- Benefits effective: 2026-01-01
- PTO: pro-rated accrual on day 1 per policy

I have completed and signed the headcount_form and attached signed_headcount_form.pdf. Marcus — per your note, we've confirmed contractor vendor spend being reallocated and attached the PO reconciliation. Please consider this approved for headcount transfer.
